finding: Return goal generated and delivered a new trajectory; transient live-LiDAR timeout moved FSM to EMERGENCY_STOP and set enable_fail_safe_=false. Input recovery does not restore this member, so automatic GEN_NEW_TRAJ remains disabled.

flags.enable_fail_safe: Configured true at init, overwritten false on sensor timeout; no true assignment elsewhere in this FSM. Setting ROS parameter later does not re-read this member.
flags.flag_escape_emergency: True after successful new trajectory; first emergency tick publishes ACTION_ABORT, then sets false; subsequent ticks require enable_fail_safe_ for recovery.
flags.have_target: Sensor timeout/emergency branch does not clear accepted target or pending manual-arm restore; target survives but emergency execution state blocks planning.
flags.manual_new_goal: A later valid user goal can explicitly change state to GEN_NEW_TRAJ through planNextWaypoint; it does not restore the fail-safe member. No such later target is evidenced in reviewed interval.

design_boundary: Local original backup contains the same disable-on-depth-loss latch; this is inherited behavior, not introduced by diagnostic export. Current code deliberately suppresses automatic recovery; no comment or logged instruction establishes user intent that a short recovered real-LiDAR dropout must permanently require a new goal.
